basic_profile.bio: G'day! I'm an Aussie based in Melbourne with a deep passion for retro gaming. I've been collecting and playing games since I was a kid. When I'm not gaming, I enjoy hanging out with my AussieDoodle, Charlie, and exploring the great outdoors. I work in IT support, which allows me flexible hours to indulge in my gaming hobby. I am single and often spend my evenings diving into nostalgic gaming sessions or browsing through tech forums.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise lies in retro video games, particularly from the late 90s and early 2000s. I've acquired extensive knowledge through years of gaming, collecting, and participating in online gaming communities. My IT background also aids in understanding the technical aspects of gaming and mods.
